llm.name: inventory
llm.description: Every editable component (blocks, heads, MLP banks, matrices with guessed roles) and the op that edits it.

llm.name: pairs_check
llm.description: Quality-check clean/corrupt prompt pairs in a JSON file (equal length, model prefers `correct` on clean, corruption hurts). Returns which pairs are usable and why others are not.

ckpt.description: checkpoint to analyse: 0..9 or final (default: the target)

llm.name: circuit
llm.description: Find the circuit for one behaviour: exact patching of every head and MLP unit over the usable pairs, t-stat + sign-agreement selection, faithfulness. edges=true adds edge attribution checked against exact edge patching. Saves it under `name`.

name.description: name to save the circuit under

top_frac.description: share of total importance to cover (default 0.8)

llm.name: grow
llm.description: (optional arg `baseline`: name of a baseline map whose co-active neighbours are offered as extra growth candidates.) Grow a circuit until keeping ONLY it clean recovers `target` of the behaviour (necessary -> sufficient). Adds upstream writers (exact edge patching), whole MLP banks and single nodes, then prunes. Saves it under `name`.

llm.name: baseline
llm.description: Map what lights up on NORMAL in-distribution prompts: per-layer dead / always-on units and clusters of units that co-activate. Correlational, not causal; read it as a starting map.

llm.name: neighbors
llm.description: Units that co-activate with a saved circuit (candidate connective tissue). With `file` (pairs) the candidates are verified: informative only if adding them beats the same number of random units.

llm.name: union
llm.description: Macro circuit: nodes present in at least min_frac of several saved circuits (build the circuits from different related prompt sets).

llm.name: overlap
llm.description: Compare saved circuits: Jaccard, nodes shared by all behaviours, nodes specific to each.

llm.name: proposals
llm.description: Turn a saved circuit's nodes into ready-to-propose edit configs (edit ONLY circuit nodes).

gamma.description: scale factor for the proposed edits (default 0)

llm.name: weights
llm.description: RAW weights of any matrix/parameter slice (<=4000 values). rows/cols as 'a:b'.

llm.name: diff
llm.description: Per-matrix relative weight change between two checkpoints (ints 0..9 or 'final').

llm.name: list_ops
llm.description: The edit ops with every argument's allowed range for THIS model. Read it before proposing.

llm.name: note
llm.description: Write a research note to the ledger (before and after every charged evaluation).

llm.name: screen
llm.description: FREE (uncharged) trial of one edit on research episodes, separate from the data the judge uses. Returns d_success with CI. Capped per run; use it to pick what to spend a charged proposal on.

llm.name: sweep
llm.description: FREE strength sweep: one op, one numeric parameter (e.g. gamma, or a dotted path like ops.1.cfg.gamma for a composite), 2-9 values. Returns the curve on research episodes and the best value. Each value uses one screen.

cfg.description: the op's arguments (the swept parameter's value is replaced)

llm.name: propose
llm.description: CHARGED evaluation of one edit against the unedited model on the selection set (rejected proposals are charged too). Returns d_success, CI, id_drop, accepted.

llm.name: state
llm.description: Compact digest of this run (budget, best charged edit, history, your notes). Use it to resume after a context reset.

nav.name: inventory
nav.description: List every editable component (feedforward banks, attention-head groups, embeddings, output head) with the op that edits it.

nav.name: neuron_scan
nav.description: Rank MLP neurons of one block by label-free memorisation contrast (train labels vs expert behaviour on held-out scenarios). Larger = more memorisation-like.

nav.name: circuit
nav.description: EXACT edge-removal contrast over the residual graph (slow, ~90 s). Read the two damage columns, not only the contrast.

nav.name: heads
nav.description: How actions are produced: declared action heads (base/nudge/expert) if the model exposes them, else decoder readouts and the exact per-writer split.

nav.name: diff
nav.description: Per-module weight change and action change between two checkpoints (ints 0..9 or 'final').

nav.name: weights
nav.description: RAW weights of any matrix/parameter slice (<=4000 values). rows/cols as 'a:b'. If it answers raw_view DISABLED the run is the summary-only arm.

nav.name: qkv
nav.description: One attention head: Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo norms, QK and OV circuit spectra, most-read input dims, exact edit handles; dump=true adds raw slices.

nav.name: attention
nav.description: Mean query x key attention of one head, entropy, example patterns.

nav.name: activity
nav.description: MLP unit activations on train vs held-out states; lists the units that behave most differently.

nav.name: list_ops
nav.description: The edit ops with every argument's allowed range for THIS model. Read it before proposing.

nav.name: probe
nav.description: FREE research probe of one edit: teacher-forced L1 change on a research set (negative = closer to the expert). Not closed-loop success. 30 per run.

nav.name: note
nav.description: Write a research note to the ledger (do this before and after every charged evaluation).

nav.name: screen
nav.description: FREE (uncharged) trial of one edit on research episodes, separate from the data the judge uses. Returns d_success with CI. Capped per run; use it to pick what to spend a charged proposal on.

nav.name: sweep
nav.description: FREE strength sweep: one op, one numeric parameter (e.g. gamma, or a dotted path like ops.1.cfg.gamma for a composite), 2-9 values. Returns the curve on research episodes and the best value. Each value uses one screen.

cfg.description: the op's arguments (the swept parameter's value is replaced)

nav.name: propose
nav.description: CHARGED evaluation of one edit against the unedited model on the selection set (rejected proposals are charged too). Returns d_success, CI, id_drop, accepted.

nav.name: state
nav.description: Compact digest of this run (budget, best charged edit, history, recent probes, your notes). Use it to resume after a context reset.
